# SchoolMyKids

> > SchoolMyKids is India's leading school discovery and education resource platform helping parents find the best CBSE, ICSE, IB, and international schools across cities like Delhi, Mumbai, Jaipur, Udaipur, and Meerut.

SchoolMyKids provides comprehensive school rankings, admission guides, educational resources including free printable worksheets, and expert insights on education trends, scholarships, and student success strategies. The platform serves parents, students, and educators with curated content on school selection, exam preparation, and modern educational developments.

## Key Topics

- CBSE Schools
- ICSE Schools
- International Schools
- IB Schools
- School Rankings
- School Admissions 2026-27
- Education Technology

- Soft Skills Development
- AR/VR Learning
